usedFor: Airtable holds your sign-ups, and Webinargeek registers them when “Record Created Or Updated” runs “Subscribe to a Single Webinar”.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Subscribe to a Single Webinar” in Webinargeek
bestTemplate.why: A new or edited Airtable row registers that person for your webinar without anyone retyping details.

watchOut: “Record Created Or Updated” also fires on edits, so one Airtable row can subscribe the same person twice.
